# Codul de procedură penală din 12 noiembrie 1968 (Legea nr. 29/1968)

Codul de procedură penală din 1968 · 35 versions, from 1969-01-01 (latest in force: 2014-02-01) · <https://legislatie.just.ro/Public/DetaliiDocument/38111>

| Provision | File | Changes | Last changed |
| --- | --- | ---: | --- |

Act id: `codul-procedura-penala-1968` (tags `codul-procedura-penala-1968/<day>`; `python tools/on.py <day> codul-procedura-penala-1968`).

## Decisions made by hand

- Codul de procedură penală din 1968: added 2026-11-02, one of the Portalul legislativ's consolidated forms per version, as for the other acts. A capture was used only if it was complete and the page showed the form its document id stands for. The forms are those listed by DetaliiDocumentAfis/38111 as captured on 2025-11-12, the newest capture of any of the act's pages: 32 forms, 32 held.
- Codul de procedură penală din 1968: the newest form held is that of 29.07.2013; amendments in force after it may be missing.
- Codul de procedură penală din 1968: the first version is the code as published in Buletinul Oficial nr. 145 of 12 November 1968 (DetaliiDocumentAfis/38111; Legea nr. 29/1968, the number Legea nr. 255/2013 gives it), in force on 1 January 1969 (its art. 524). Git cannot store a date before 1970, so that commit is dated 1 January 1970 by the builder; the real day is in its In-force trailer.
- Codul de procedură penală din 1968: the portal holds no form between 1969 and the republication of 30 April 1997 (Monitorul Oficial nr. 78, under art. 4 of Legea nr. 141/1996, enacted 5 November 1996 and published in Monitorul Oficial nr. 289 of 14 November 1996; read as published, DetaliiDocumentAfis/8713). So the changes made in those years, including those of the republication of 26 April 1973 (Buletinul Oficial nr. 58-59, under Legea nr. 7/1973), which the portal does not hold, arrive with the republished text, and its changes that no note explains are credited to Legea nr. 141/1996, as the republication note says. Nor does it hold a form between 1997 and 1 October 2001, so the changes of those years arrive with that form.
- Codul de procedură penală din 1968: the portal lists two forms under 27 June 2003. The second (49270) reads in its own heading "actualizat până la data de 27 noiembrie 2003" and prints OUG nr. 109/2003 of 24 October 2003, which the forms of 27 June and 14 July 2003 do not; it is read at 27 November 2003.
- Codul de procedură penală din 1968: arts. 514-518 were repealed by art. 40 pct. 6 of Legea nr. 704/2001 privind asistența judiciară internațională în materie penală ("Articolele 514-518 se abroga."; enacted 3 December 2001, published in Monitorul Oficial nr. 807 of 17 December 2001; read as published, DetaliiDocumentAfis/32817), in force 30 days after publication (its art. 41): 16 January 2002, a repeal version of its own between the forms of 1 October 2001 and 27 June 2003. The forms of 2003-2004 print them as "Abrogat."; from 23 December 2004, after Legea nr. 302/2004 repealed Legea nr. 704/2001, the portal prints their earlier text again. That is the publisher's error and is left out of every later form (coordinator ruling): art. 64 alin. (3) of Legea nr. 24/2000 provides that "nu este admis ca prin abrogarea unui act de abrogare anterior să se repună în vigoare actul normativ inițial", so repealing Legea nr. 704/2001 did not bring the five articles back into force.
- Codul de procedură penală din 1968: articles numbered with a letter after the superscript ("Articolul 160^a", "Articolul 160^2a", "Articolul 385^10a") are filed under keys that keep the letter (art-160-a, art-160-2-a, art-385-10-a), with the title as printed.
- Codul de procedură penală din 1968: repealed in full by art. 108 of Legea nr. 255/2013 pentru punerea în aplicare a Legii nr. 135/2010 privind Codul de procedură penală (enacted 19 July 2013, published in Monitorul Oficial nr. 515 of 14 August 2013; read as published, DetaliiDocumentAfis/150697), from the day that law took effect with the new Code of Criminal Procedure, 1 February 2014 (its arts. 103 and 104). The record ends with a version that removes every article, credited to Legea nr. 255/2013. The portal lists no form after that of 29 July 2013, so any amendment between that day and the repeal is missing.
- Codul de procedură penală din 1968: some forms print a wrong article number that repeats an earlier article's, between the two articles it sits between; Lexifina's code files it under the number in sequence: "Articolul 148" read as art. 178.
- Codul de procedură penală din 1968: the portal editorial notes printed as paragraphs of an article (on a Constitutional Court ruling, a rectification, a provision put back in force) are not text: 805 such paragraphs across all forms, for example «* Alin. 3 a art. 385^9 este abrogat prin Legea 456/2001 publ», «* Alin. 3 a art. 385^9 este abrogat prin Legea nr. 456/2001 », «* LEGEA nr. 704 din 3 decembrie 2001 a fost abrogata de LEGE».
- Codul de procedură penală din 1968: articles a form leaves out are shown repealed on the day the repealing act took effect (on publication for an emergency ordinance, 3 days after for a law, unless the act sets its own day), credited to that act as its repeal note names it: art. 514, left out from the form of 27.06.2003: repealed by Legea nr. 704/2001, in force 16.01.2002 (30 days after publication in Monitorul Oficial nr. 807 of 17 December 2001 (its art. 41)); art. 515, left out from the form of 27.06.2003: repealed by Legea nr. 704/2001, in force 16.01.2002 (30 days after publication in Monitorul Oficial nr. 807 of 17 December 2001 (its art. 41)); art. 516, left out from the form of 27.06.2003: repealed by Legea nr. 704/2001, in force 16.01.2002 (30 days after publication in Monitorul Oficial nr. 807 of 17 December 2001 (its art. 41)); art. 517, left out from the form of 27.06.2003: repealed by Legea nr. 704/2001, in force 16.01.2002 (30 days after publication in Monitorul Oficial nr. 807 of 17 December 2001 (its art. 41)); art. 518, left out from the form of 27.06.2003: repealed by Legea nr. 704/2001, in force 16.01.2002 (30 days after publication in Monitorul Oficial nr. 807 of 17 December 2001 (its art. 41)).
- Codul de procedură penală din 1968: repeals dated before the form that first leaves the article out: 2002-01-16 (art-514, art-515, art-516, art-517, art-518; form 27.06.2003).

## Constitutional Court findings not applied to this text

The Constitutional Court found the provisions below unconstitutional in a way the files here do not show as struck out: only some words inside a provision, a reading of it, a rule read from it, provisions read together with others, a provision amended or repealed before the decision took effect on it, a finding not matched automatically to one provision here, or a decision given before the 2003 revision of the Constitution. The text here is unchanged; read the decision. `data/court-notes.csv` lists every such finding.

- **[Decizia nr. 60/1994](../../../jurisprudenta/ccr/1994/60/)**, Monitorul Oficial nr. 57 din 28 martie 1995 · art. 149 · decided before the 2003 revision of the Constitution

  > constata ca dispoziţiile art. 149 alineatul final din Codul de procedură penală sunt neconstituţionale în măsura în care se interpretează în sensul că durata arestării dispusă de instanţa în cursul judecaţii poate depăşi 30 de zile fără a fi necesară prelungirea, în condiţiile art. 23 din Constituţie.

  Given before the 2003 revision of the Constitution (no 45-day rule) and published on 1995-03-28. The decision was open to appeal (recurs) when given; a decision on appeal may have changed it. The text here is unchanged; read the decision.

- **[Decizia nr. 129/1996](../../../jurisprudenta/ccr/1996/129/)**, Monitorul Oficial nr. 158 din 16 iulie 1997 · art. 332 alin. (3) · decided before the 2003 revision of the Constitution

  > Admite excepţia de neconstituţionalitate a art. 332 alin. 3 din Codul de procedură penală, cat priveşte limitarea dreptului de a exercita recursul numai la inculpatul arestat \[…\]

  Given before the 2003 revision of the Constitution (no 45-day rule) and published on 1997-07-16. The decision was open to appeal (recurs) when given; a decision on appeal may have changed it. The text here is unchanged; read the decision.

- **[Decizia nr. 546/1997](../../../jurisprudenta/ccr/1997/546/)**, Monitorul Oficial nr. 98 din 2 martie 1998 · art. 149 alin. (3) · decided before the 2003 revision of the Constitution

  > Admite excepţia de neconstituţionalitate a art. 149 alin. 3 din Codul de procedură penală \[…\] şi constata ca prevederea potrivit căreia "Arestarea inculpatului în cursul judecaţii durează până la soluţionarea definitivă a cauzei" este neconstitutionala, urmând, în legătură cu durata arestării, să se facă aplicarea directa a art. 23 alin. (4) din Constituţie.

  Given before the 2003 revision of the Constitution (no 45-day rule) and published on 1998-03-02; final. Under Constituția din 1991, art. 145 alin. (2), the Court's decisions are binding and have effect only for the future. The text here is unchanged; read the decision.

- **[Decizia nr. 486/1997](../../../jurisprudenta/ccr/1997/486/)**, Monitorul Oficial nr. 105 din 6 martie 1998 · art. 278 · decided before the 2003 revision of the Constitution

  > constata ca art. 278 din Codul de procedură penală este constituţional numai în măsura în care nu opreşte persoana nemultumita de soluţionarea plângerii împotriva măsurilor sau actelor efectuate de procuror ori efectuate pe baza dispoziţiilor date de acesta şi care nu ajung în faţa instanţelor judecătoreşti să se adreseze justiţiei în temeiul art. 21 din Constituţie, ce urmează să se aplice în mod direct.

  Given before the 2003 revision of the Constitution (no 45-day rule) and published on 1998-03-06; final. Under Constituția din 1991, art. 145 alin. (2), the Court's decisions are binding and have effect only for the future. The text here is unchanged; read the decision.

  > constata ca dispoziţiile art. 159 alin. 7 teza a III-a din Codul de procedură penală sunt neconstituţionale în măsura în care se interpretează în sensul că efectul suspensiv al recursului, declarat împotriva încheierii prin care s-a dispus asupra prelungirii arestării preventive, poate depăşi durata de 30 de zile, prevăzută la art. 23 alin.
